loaded_by: the field runtime pass 0x0025D9E0 on scene manager 1 (event 212 at 0x0025DAE8, 0x0032FC30 at 0x0025DAED)
synopsis: A setup scene that shows nothing: its one function sets the script globals from the story counter and ends the event.
plays_when: On every field load, including a return to the area the game keeps in memory, as soon as the field is loaded; it shows nothing and the field's own scripts wait until it has run. The manager bind 0x0026C8C0, which runs each time a zone's script arrives (0x003304A0, 0x0032F850, 0x0032F966), rewrites the flags byte of manager slot 0 (byte +0x10 of the slot at 0x02098E10) with bits 0x1, 0x8 and 0x10 clear and bits 0x2 and 0x80 set (0x0026CB0B, 0x0026CB1B, 0x0026CB67, 0x0026CBDC and 0x0026CC45). On slot 0, with bit 0x80 set (0x0025DAAA), the field runtime pass 0x0025D9E0 then waits until the field is loaded (0x02ADD0D8 through 0x00377DB0, 0x0025DACC); with bits 0x10 and 0x8 clear it requests event 212 into manager 1 (0x0032FC30(1, 0xD4), 0x0025DAE8 and 0x0025DAED) and sets bit 0x8 (0x0025DAF2); with bit 0x8 set it holds slot 0 while manager 1 has the load pending (0x0032F6C0, 0x0025DAFB) or its flags bit 0x1 or byte +0x13 is set (0x020990A8 and 0x020990AB), and then sets bit 0x10 (0x0025DB1E). Of the 55 functions of the executable that address the five manager slots directly, the bind is the only one that clears bit 0x8: the other writes to that byte set bits 0x8 and 0x10 (0x0025DAF2 and 0x0025DB1E) or bit 0x1 (0x0026D305), or clear bit 0x1 (0x00262DA8). The scene is one function: it sets the conversation stage (g_com_会話段階変数), the party-size value (g_com_パーティ人数変数), the Rabanastre closure value (g_iw_ラバナスタ通行止め状態) and a story-stage value (global_flag[3]) from the story counter, counts the thirteen Espers held, Belias (0xC012) to Zodiark (0xC01E), into the Esper count (battle_global_flag[0]), moves the cluckatrice hunt (quest 160) from a stage of 100 to 119 on to stage 120 from story counter 4100 (After the truth clouded by Mist), sets each of 48 battle bytes still at 0 to 1 (three of them only within a story counter range, and two of those, Hydro's and Tyrant's, to 2 past it), writes the teleport status for the story counter range, and disposes of itself (pre_z0000 lines 76, 82, 112, 113, 115, 123, 129, 165, 177, 197, 300, 307, 319, 326, 382, 389, 437, 440 and 441).
